description: This file defines a Flask route using Flask-Smorest to implement a health check endpoint. It creates a Blueprint and a class-based view 'HealthCheck' that responds with a 'Healthy' message on a GET request at the root URL.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView that handles GET requests for the health check endpoint.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests, returning a JSON indicating the service is healthy.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
